rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for lively energy and enthusiasm.

example.english: This group of young people always show such exuberance when exercising.
example.traditional: 呢隊後生仔做運動成日都咁有活力。
example.jyutping: ne1 deoi6 hau6 saang1 zai2 zou6 wan6 dung6 seng4 jat6 dou1 gam3 jau5 wut6 lik6

rows.note: Use this when the exuberance is mainly enthusiastic warmth or eagerness rather than physical liveliness.

example.english: They welcome every customer with such exuberance.
example.traditional: 佢用熱情招呼每一位客人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 jit6 cing4 ziu1 fu1 mui5 jat1 wai6 haak3 jan4

rows.note: Use this for fresh, youthful liveliness and spirited energy.

example.english: When I got to the office this morning, the new hires were full of exuberance.
example.traditional: 朝早返到公司，成班新人都充滿朝氣。
example.jyutping: ziu1 zou2 faan2 dou3 gung1 si1 sing4 baan1 san1 jan4 dou1 cung1 mun5 ziu1 hei3
